params.1273: Given by Old Man Ral, in Meiyerditch, for completing all Elite Tasks in Morytania.
params.1292: Morytania legs 4 and magic lamps worth a total of 140,000XP in a skill of your choice. Robin offers 39 lots of bonemeal in exchange for bones, and 39 free buckets of slime per day.
params.1274: The legs gain the following additional benefits:
params.1275: - Each essence has a 10% chance of gaining a second blood rune at the Blood altar.
params.1276: - 50% more Prayer XP from burning vyrewatch.
params.1277: - 20% chance of creating a 4-dose prayer renewal potion when making it in Morytania.
params.1278: - 10% additional Slayer XP for kills in the Slayer Tower when on a task.
params.1279: - Double mushroom yield on the patch near Canifis.
